core_frameworks: FACE_REACTION — Expressive human face with bold 3-word text overlay, proven highest CTR format
VS_COMPARISON — Split-screen comparison format creating instant curiosity about which is better
CURIOSITY_GAP — Blurred or hidden reveal element with teaser text that demands a click
LISTICLE_NUMBER — Giant bold number with topic text creating scannable value-promise thumbnails
BEFORE_AFTER — Split transformation visual with dramatic contrast that proves results
SHOCKING_STAT — Bold statistic or data point that challenges assumptions and demands attention
HOW_TO_RESULT — End-result showcase with 'HOW TO' or 'I MADE' text showing achievable outcome
STORY_HOOK — Narrative-driven thumbnail with emotional scene and cliffhanger text

youtube.creative_rules: Maximum CTR thumbnail. 1280x720 optimized. Bold text 3-5 words MAX. Expressive face or dramatic visual. High contrast colors. Text on left or right third, never center-blocked. Readable at mobile size. No small text. No clutter. Rule of thirds composition. This thumbnail must make someone STOP scrolling and CLICK.

meta.creative_rules: Blog preview card or video cover. Clean headline design. Engaging topic visual. Professional content preview quality. Clear value proposition in 3-5 words.

instagram.creative_rules: Reel cover or carousel cover. Bold topic text that hooks. Feed-stopping visual. Consistent brand aesthetic. 4:5 portrait for maximum real estate.

tiktok.creative_rules: Video cover frame. Bold hook text at top. Dramatic visual that demands swipe. Full-screen 9:16 vertical. Maximum scroll-stopping power.

pinterest.creative_rules: Blog cover pin or video pin cover. Compelling topic visual. Bold text overlay. Save-worthy design quality. 2:3 vertical pin format.

facebook.creative_rules: Blog share image or video preview. Article preview card quality. Engaging topic visual that drives clicks from feed. Share-worthy design.

x.creative_rules: Twitter card image or thread header. Bold statement visual. Maximum timeline visibility. Sharp professional design. 16:9 landscape.

visual_direction.lighting: bright glowing beauty light, high contrast, f/2.8
